يعتزلوا (form VIII)
# يَعْتَزِلُوا (yaʕtazilū) /jaʕ.ta.zi.luː/: third-person masculine plural non-past active subjunctive/jussive of اِعْتَزَلَ (iʕtazala)
# يُعْتَزَلُوا (yuʕtazalū) /juʕ.ta.za.luː/: third-person masculine plural non-past passive subjunctive/jussive of اِعْتَزَلَ (iʕtazala)
